_help: What each bot says on the result panel. youWin: you beat it; youLose: it beat you; youSurrender: you gave up. Keep each line short (70 characters at most) and friendly. 6 to 8 lines per list.

youWin: Great game! You're really good at this!
Wow, nice shots! Can you teach me that bank shot?
You won fair and square. Well played!
That was so much fun! Same time tomorrow?
I tried my best, and you were better. Yay you!
Good game! My cannons are still a bit dizzy.
Hooray for you! I'll practise my aiming.
youLose: Oh! I won? That was lucky. Good game!
Good game! You almost had me, honestly.
Phew, that was close! Want to go again?
I won! But you made it really fun.
Thanks for the game! You'll get me next time.
Did I win? Oh my. Good game, friend!
That was a nice match. Rematch?
youSurrender: Aw, it's okay! Want to try again?
No worries! Every game is practice.
That's alright. Take a breather and come back!
Good effort! You'll get it next round.
It happens! I'll be here when you're ready.
Okay! Thanks for playing with me.

youWin: Ha! Nice one. You got me there!
Okay, okay, you win this round. Rematch?
Good game! I'll be polishing my cannons.
You beat me! I'm telling my toaster.
Well played! That last capture was slick.
Fine, you're good. I'm onto your tricks now!
Nice! Best two out of three?
youLose: Gotcha! Good game though.
Pip pip hooray! That one's mine.
Ha, I win! Want to try another map?
Close one! My cannons say thanks for playing.
Victory dance! Okay, done. Good game!
I'll take that win. Rematch?
Not bad! But not quite fast enough.
youSurrender: Leaving so soon? Next time, then!
White flag spotted! Good game anyway.
Fair enough. Come back for round two!
I'll count that one. Rematch later?
Taking a break? My cannons will wait.
Surrender accepted! Shake hands?

youWin: Hmph. Well played. I won't make it easy next time.
You earned that one. Don't get used to it.
Not bad at all. I'm recalculating.
Good game. Next round, I'm not holding back.
Respect. That was sharp shooting.
You found a gap. I'll close it.
Fine. You win this one. Rematch, now.
youLose: Good game. Train harder and try again.
Every angle covered. That's how it's done.
You put up a fight. Not enough, though.
Win secured. Want another shot?
Close, but I read your plan.
Clean sweep. Come back when you're ready.
That's the board. Mine, this time.
youSurrender: Giving up? I respect the call. Rematch soon.
Smart retreat. The board will still be here.
Surrender noted. Come back stronger.
Not today, then. I'll be waiting.
You saw it coming. Good instincts.
Fine by me. Next round, finish it.

youWin: That didn't count. My shots were lagging.
Pure luck. I was clearly about to win.
I let you win. Out of pity. Obviously.
Rematch. Now. That one was a glitch.
The sun was in my eyes. Indoors. Somehow.
You didn't deserve that. Not even a little.
My cannons were warming up. Try that again!
Hmph! I demand a recount of every cannon.
youLose: As expected. Bow to Vex!
Was that your best? Adorable.
Too easy. Did you even try?
Another victory for me. How boring.
I'd say good game, but it wasn't. For you.
Mwahaha! Every cannon is mine!
Perfect aim, perfect plan, perfect me.
You should try Easy. Just a thought.
youSurrender: Ha! Running away already?
A wise choice. You were doomed anyway.
I accept your surrender. And your shame.
Smart. Nobody beats Vex. Nobody!
Giving up? Bold of you to even start.
